headline: Aisha understands the practice before Android asks her to sign in
overview: A fresh Android install explains language, wisdom, play, and intention, then stops honestly at the account boundary.
payoff: She knows what the practice is and why an account is requested before she chooses a provider.

scenes.title: Understand the native practice
scenes.narrative: Aisha walks the real Android onboarding from language through intention.

scenes.title: Stop at sign-in without creating state
scenes.narrative: The fresh package reaches Google and email sign-in. The walkthrough does not select an account or invent an authenticated result.
